messages:
alex: quick heads-up — onboarding vanguard-v2q (int4) canary started and we're seeing structured-output funcall JSON parse failures ~6% of runs. fp16 mirror is ~0.5% so looks quant-specific.
infra-bot: canary deploy vanguard-v2q -> route: canary-03 (deployed by @deploybot)
priya: sample raw model output we captured (truncated):
```
MODEL OUT: "{\"action\": \"createIssue\", \"args\": {\"title\": \"Crash on save\", \"body\": \"Repro steps:\\n1) open app\\n2) save\\u0007\"}...}"
```
alex: that has a BEL control char (\u0007) embedded and a truncated suffix. streaming chunks probably cut mid-utf8 boundary or tokenizer produced control token.
sam: are these runs coming from batching / kvprefix? int4 tokenization differences can shift byte boundaries and make streaming send mid-codepoint.
luca: i'll spin a kvprefix-off canary mirror (same traffic slice) for 30m and collect sample outputs.
nora: suggest adding a non-invasive "soft-json-wrap" repair flow: on parse failure try these steps in order (1) regex-extract first `{...}` block (2) remove control chars and map common weird tokens (BEL, \x00) to spaces (3) repair trailing commas and balance braces (closing) (4) reparse. emit parse_repair=true telemetry. keep as opt-in for canary.
priya: concrete plan: 1) run kvprefix-off canary (luca) 2) land parser-repair shim in canary config (sam) 3) add auto-fallback policy to fp16 for user-critical funcalls after 1 retry (nora). timelines: luca today, sam to PR today, nora tomorrow.
alex: example fallback config we can plumb into route: 
```
{
  "route": "canary-03",
  "on_parse_fail": [
    {"action": "retry_with_repair", "max_retries": 1},
    {"action": "fallback_model", "model": "vanguard-v2"}
  ]
}
```
sam: keep retry budget low (1) so we don't amplify tail latency. also capture tokenization_delta and kvprefix flag per run to correlate.
luca: uploading sample dump to: s3://redwood-canary/vanguard-v2q/2026-03-21/parse-fail-samples.json (will include raw model output + tokenization delta + route metadata)
priya: perf note: the repair step adds ~10-15ms median when triggered (measured locally). acceptable for canary but need to gate on SLA before rolling to prod.
nora: also consider an NDJSON fallback: if we detect multiple objects separated by newlines, try treating as NDJSON and pick first valid object. that helps with streaming chunk boundary cases.
alex: ok action items recap: @luca run kvprefix-off canary + upload samples; @sam land parser-repair + unit+e2e tests; @nora add fallback policy + NDJSON attempt; @priya track parse metrics (parse_success_rate, parse_repair_rate, funcall_success) and prepare a brief 3PM PT checkin.
priya: I'm adding a dashboard panel for parse_success_rate by model_variant and kvprefix flag.
alex: thanks — if we see repair fixes >80% of failures on int4 and kvprefix toggle reduces delta, we can consider a controlled rollout. otherwise schedule a rollback to fp16 for canary. :thumbsup:
